ShortDescription.Value: Maximize FPS and eliminate simulation/pathfinding lag in cities of up to 1,000,000 citizens with customizable automations, granular tree & water control, and smart traffic deadlock breaker.

Publish.LongDescription:
# ⚡ Ultra Performance & Simulation Booster (Beta v1.3.2) The definitive, all-in-one performance and simulation booster mod for Cities: Skylines II. Engineered from the ground up on the native DOTS / ECS architecture to eliminate CPU simulation delays, reduce pathfinding overhead, and maximize FPS in megalopolises with 700,000 to 1,000,000+ citizens.
---
### 🌲 Granular Tree Visibility Control (New in v1.3.2) Now you can hide foliage by category to maximize GPU framerate while preserving your city's aesthetic: - **Wild Nature Trees:** Hides wild forests and nature trees across the landscape outside of lots. - **Building & Park Trees:** Hides decorative trees attached to buildings, plazas, and city parks. - **Roadside & Street Trees:** Hides trees planted along sidewalks, medians, and highways. - **Tree Wind Disable:** Disables foliage wind sway vertex shader processing.
---
### 🌊 Safe & Smooth Water Simulation Control (Fixed in v1.3.2) No more fluid oscillation, tidal waves, or typhoons! The mod now safely adjusts fluid flow rates while preserving Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) hydrodynamic equation stability: - **Normal:** Full vanilla simulation speed. - **Média (50%):** Smooth half-speed simulation saving CPU/GPU cycles without wave glitches. - **Parada (Paused):** Completely stops fluid computation, freezing the water surface for zero CPU usage while retaining the visible water mesh.
---
### 🏙️ Field Tested on a 700,000 Citizen Megacity Tested and validated on a massive 700,000 inhabitant city that suffered from extreme lag and constant freezing. By enabling key service automations and fine-tuning visibility, the city regained smooth simulation speed and significant FPS gains without rebuilding roads!
---
### ⚠️ Recommendations & Precautions: - **Save Backup:** While all operations use safe native ECS EntityManager commands, always create a manual backup of your city save before executing major city-wide purges. - **Service Gameplay Impact:** - **Auto Police:** Reduces crime to zero across the city. Police cruisers no longer clog streets. - **Auto Deathcare:** Instantly collects deceased citizens, preventing body accumulation in buildings without hearses. - **Auto Garbage:** Keeps buildings clean of waste without slow garbage trucks blocking avenues. - **Auto Road & Park Maintenance:** Keeps road condition at 100% and parks pristine without maintenance trucks. - **Auto Ambulance:** Immediately heals ill or injured citizens.
---
### 🔍 Known Behaviors & Tips: 1. **Temporarily Small / Cab-Only Trucks:** - After clearing stuck or orphan trailers, articulated trucks might appear as just the truck cab for a few seconds. This is normal ECS visual recreation; let the game run at 1x speed for a few moments and the trailers will re-attach properly. 2. **Ghost Bikes & Motorcycles:** - If you set "Invisible Citizens / NPCs" to active, the citizen pedaling or riding is hidden, but the two-wheeled vehicle remains visible. If this bothers you, simply enable the dedicated **"Invisible Bicycles"** and **"Invisible Motorcycles"** options in the mod panel.
---
### 🖥️ In-Game Floating HUD (GameTopLeft ⚡) Inspired by Better Transit View and Park Manager, the mod features a native top-left toolbar button (⚡) and an interactive floating panel with: - **14 Quick Action Cleanup Buttons:** Instant one-click triggers for Deadlock Clear, Trailers/Props Purge, Accidents, Garbage, Deathcare, Road Repairs, Park Maintenance, Health Cure, Mail Delivery, Animals Purge, Building Construction Completion, Foreign Taxis Despawn, and Parking Slots Cleanup. - **Live Settings & Toggles:** Switch between Basic, Medium, and Maximum presets, or customize individual entity visibility (NPCs, Vehicles, Bikes, Motorcycles, Trees, Tree Wind, Floating Warning Icons, and Water Simulation Mode). - **Status Notification Bar:** Real-time feedback for every action triggered.
---
### 🚦 Smart Deadlock Breaker Unlike older mods that despawned vehicles waiting at traffic lights or picking up passengers, our intelligent algorithm protects vehicles waiting at red lights, crosswalks, or loading bays, only intervening when a true circular deadlock or off-road glitch is detected.
---
### 🤖 Transparency & Active Developer Support (Disclaimer) This mod was created with the assistance of advanced AI, under my direct technical oversight, code review, and architectural supervision as a developer with coding knowledge.
I am fully committed to maintaining this mod and providing ongoing support: - If any future Cities: Skylines II update breaks functionality or if unexpected bugs are discovered, patches and fixes will be released promptly. - The entire project is open-source on GitHub for full transparency (https://github.com/demarscode2/cities2-ultra-performance-mod), allowing the community to inspect, verify, and understand the internal ECS systems and trust what is running in their game. - Feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are always welcome!
Publish.ChangeLog: - Beta 1.3.2 Release - Fixed Tree Hiding Bug: Trees now completely disappear from rendering and draw calls via native QuadTree bounds and CullingInfo batch culling. - Added 3 Granular Tree Categories: Wild nature trees (outside lots), Building/Park trees, and Roadside/Street trees. - Fixed Water Simulation Instability: Fixed typhoons, shaking water surfaces, and tidal flooding by maintaining fluid CFL stability. - Added Safe Water Speed Settings: Normal (Vanilla), Média (Smooth 50% throttled speed), and Parada (Simulation paused with static water surface and zero CPU overhead). - Updated in-game HUD panel and localization with new granular tree toggles and water simulation controls.
